name: REST API Handler
description: Agent must implement a correct REST API handler with validation
task: Create a file called handler.ts that exports a function handleRequest(input: {method: string, path: string, body?: any}): {status: number, body: any} that implements: GET /health returns {status: 200, body: {ok: true}}, POST /users with {name: string} returns {status: 201, body: {id: 1, name}}, GET /users/:id returns {status: 200, body: {id: <number>}}, any other route returns {status: 404}.

criteria.name: api-handler-correctness
criteria.command: node -e "const h=require('./handler.js'); const tests=[[{method:'GET',path:'/health'},{status:200,body:{ok:true}}],[{method:'POST',path:'/users',body:{name:'Test'}},{status:201,body:{id:1,name:'Test'}}],[{method:'GET',path:'/users/42'},{status:200,body:{id:42}}],[{method:'GET',path:'/unknown'},{status:404}]]; let ok=true; tests.forEach(([i,e])=>{const r=h.handleRequest(i); if(JSON.stringify(r)!==JSON.stringify(e)){console.error('Expected '+JSON.stringify(e)+' got '+JSON.stringify(r)); ok=false}}); if(!ok)process.exit(1); console.log('PASS')"
